The second applies the Caution's person test (born after January 1, 2008, claimed as a dependent, or a student) to the column's contributions on lines 1 and 2; the project figures lines 1 to 5 as printed and zeroes the ineligible person's column on line 6 (f8880.line6a/6b through f8880.elig_a/elig_b, the same test: person.sav_ineligible is sav_born false, sav_student true, or sa.dependent and sav_claimed both true). Line 7 and every line after it are the same on both sides; only lines 3 and 5 of an ineligible column differ, and the form prints no instruction for where the zero goes. The binding reading amb.2025.savers_ineligible_column (owner decision 4) puts it on line 6 of that column. f8880 p. 1, Caution, "The person(s) who made the qualified contribution or elective deferral (a) was born after January 1, 2008; (b) is claimed as a dependent on someone else's 2025 tax return; or (c) was a student".

Ruling: ambiguity; amb.2025.savers_ineligible_column. f8880 p. 1, Caution: "You cannot take this credit if either of the following applies. ... The person(s) who made the qualified contribution or elective deferral (a) was born after January 1, 2008; (b) is claimed as a dependent on someone else’s 2025 tax return; or (c) was a student". The difference is the placement of the ineligible column's zero, decided by amb.2025.savers_ineligible_column (owner decision 4, Stage 15): "On a joint return, an ineligible spouse's own column is zero (line 6 of that column)", chosen as f8880.line6a/6b through f8880.elig_a/elig_b; the candidate zeroes the column from lines 1 and 2 instead. Line 7 and every later line are the same under both placements. Triage executable-triage-v2 (`../triage/f8880.json`; 1,306 fixtures, 500 generated returns seed 20261026, no partial records; 1,806 comparisons): 1,792 of 1,806 agree; 9 value (7 on refused returns), 5 candidate-unknown. Witness 3 classm.clcw.3 (taxpayer born after January 1, 2008, sav_born false; project 735.00, candidate 0.00) is the placement. Witnesses 1-2 classm.f5695.2[.deepseek] (completed; project 5,616.00, candidate 0.00) have person.sav_claimed true with sa.dependent false, an answer the interview never asks (person.sav_claimed help: "Asked because someone can claim you or your spouse as a dependent") and the project never reads (person.sav_ineligible tests it only with sa.dependent), so not a reachable record. The unknowns (2 on completed returns: witness 6 stage16.cleanup.mut.clwb_three_figured, witness 8 stage16.cleanup.f5695_small_wind; project 0.00, no contribution entered) are a minor candidate error: it asks the person test (sav_born, sav_claimed) before any contribution exists, an answer the source does not need when line 1 is zero. Project stands.

Ruling: model error; minor, no value difference. f8880 p. 2, Line 4: "Enter the total amount of distributions you, and your spouse if filing jointly, received after 2022 and before the due date of your 2025 return (including extensions) from any of the following types of plans". Triage executable-triage-v2 (`../triage/f8880.json`; 1,306 fixtures, 500 generated returns seed 20261026, no partial records; 1,806 comparisons): 1,805 of 1,806 agree; 1 candidate-unknown on a completed return that is not joint (witness 0 stage16.cleanup.f5695_small_wind, project 0.00): the candidate adds person.sav_prior_joint without the joint-return guard, and that input is asked "On a joint return" only (its question begins so); on any other return all the filer's 2023, 2024 and early-2026 distributions are person.sav_prior_other, which both sides count. The candidate so requires an answer the interface defines only for joint returns and the source does not need. On joint returns both sides add both spouses' joint-year amounts, as "include both spouses’ amounts in both columns" (f8880 p. 2, Line 4) requires; the 2026 part follows amb.2025.savers_2026_joint. Earlier rounds ruled this line representation by reading; the v2 triage shows the completed-return unknown. Project stands.

Ruling: representation; project retained. On a joint return both sides add both spouses' person.sav_prior_joint (the project by a sum over the two person entries, the second by one sum per role), so they agree. They differ only on a return that is not joint, where the second adds the taxpayer's person.sav_prior_joint and the project counts nothing for it: the project asks that input for a joint return only (its question begins "On a joint return:") and on any other return puts all of the filer's 2023, 2024 and early-2026 distributions in person.sav_prior_other ("on a return that is not a joint return: all your distributions in 2023 and 2024, and in 2026 before the due date"), which both sides count in column (a). f8880 p. 2, Line 4, "Enter the total amount of distributions you, and your spouse if filing jointly, received after 2022 and before the due date of your 2025 return"; "If you're filing a joint return, include both spouses' amounts in both columns. Exception. Don't include your spouse's distributions with yours ... if you and your spouse didn't file a joint return for the year the distribution was received". The 2026 part follows amb.2025.savers_2026_joint.

Inside the joint branch the project's redundant inner guard takes the same sum. Project stands.
